title: SlicerDDSurfer: an integrated 3D Slicer workflow for anatomical reconstruction and connectivity analysis from diffusion MRI
description: SlicerDDSurfer is a 3D Slicer scripted module and command-line workflow for diffusion MRI-derived anatomical reconstruction, connectivity analysis, quality-control review, and provenance capture.
notes: Archive source code and release metadata only after model-weight, template, validation-data, and Git LFS asset redistribution terms have been reviewed. Do not include restricted assets unless their redistribution and DOI-archive permissions are confirmed.
